inspiration: Sun shafts: a post pass reads a shared uniform block that carries the sun's screen position, sun colour, weather kind and time/wind values; a comment in the block says the sun-ray pass takes an occlusion-mask size from its parameter block. Recreate it from scratch with a different ray count and a dusk tint. Reference: src/AcDream.App/Rendering/Shaders/atmospheric_sun_rays.frag with atmospheric_common.glsl (ray-pass body not read; the description is from the block's comments).

Foliage wind: one shared clock plus a wind vector (mean, gust, direction) drives sway for every instance, and per-batch flag bits decide which batches move at all. Recreate the sway with our own gust wave that travels across a field. Reference: src/AcDream.App/Rendering/Shaders/foliage_wind.glsl, lines 1-20 read.

Sky: a full-screen sky shader with a bindless texture index and a per-draw parameter block, separate from the mesh path. Recreate with an original gradient and cloud layer. Reference: src/AcDream.App/Rendering/Shaders/sky.frag (header read; body not read).

Detail-texture blend: a small helper weights a detail texture's RGB by the material alpha times the detail's own alpha, mixing it over a base colour. Recreate this as a 'grime or wear' layer on armour and terrain with our own detail maps. Reference: src/AcDream.App/Rendering/Shaders/retail_detail_material.glsl (short file, read in full).

Bloom chain: separate downsample and blur passes (atmospheric_bloom_downsample.frag, atmospheric_bloom_blur.frag) plus a filmic tonemap pass. Useful as a reference structure for a glow pass on fire, magic and metal highlights. Shader bodies not read.

Atmosphere as one shared uniform block for all post effects (sun screen position, colour, weather, policy factors, inverse view-projection). Idea to copy as structure: one place to tune time-of-day and weather for every effect pass. Reference: src/AcDream.App/Rendering/Shaders/atmospheric_common.glsl lines 1-20.

briefs.label: Dusk shaft curtain
briefs.why: A warm low sun behind a tree line reads well at 375 wide: a few broad beams with a soft falloff give a mood without any sprites. One signature effect: light shafts that follow the sun's screen point.
briefs.keep: kept: a single sun-screen-position uniform drives the shaft pass; shafts are masked by occlusion, not drawn everywhere.
briefs.change: changed: our own tint (dusk amber, not noon white), our own ray count and falloff, and shafts that break up with a drifting dust layer. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy. (Ray-pass body not read; the 'keep' trait comes from the block's comments.)

briefs.label: Gust-wave grass field
briefs.why: A field where the whole crop bends in one slow wave reads at 375 wide and gives a signature motion that is cheap to draw. Only flagged plants sway, so rocks and walls stay still.
briefs.keep: kept: one shared clock and wind vector for every instance; per-batch flag bits as the opt-in for sway.
briefs.change: changed: our own motion curve (a wave that travels across the field instead of an even sway), our own flag layout, and a different plant silhouette. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.

briefs.label: Worn-metal detail layer
briefs.why: A detail map that only shows up where the base colour is strong gives a worn, used look to armour and terrain at no extra draw cost. One signature material: scuffs that read as wear, not as paint.
briefs.keep: kept: a detail RGB weighted by material alpha times the detail's own alpha, mixed over the base colour.
briefs.change: changed: our own detail textures (scratches and wear, not noise), our own weighting curve, and a metal tint instead of a stone one. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.

briefs.label: Two-pass glow bloom
briefs.why: A downsample-then-blur bloom gives fire, magic and polished metal a halo on a low-end GPU. Signature effect: a soft halo that only appears on the brightest pixels.
briefs.keep: kept: downsample pass then blur pass, feeding a final composite.
briefs.change: changed: our own threshold ramp, a colour-shifted halo (cool blue for magic, warm for fire), and a different number of mip levels. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.
